campaign.title: Rename G40_05_PROVIDER while preserving identity and bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION G40_05_PROVIDER(X)
  G40_05_PROVIDER = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    G40_05_PROVIDER = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 112) THEN
    G40_05_PROVIDER = 112
  END IF
  G40_05_PROVIDER = G40_05_PROVIDER
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_05_PRED_1(X)
  G40_05_PRED_1 = 0
  IF (G40_05_PROVIDER(X) >= 63) THEN
    G40_05_PRED_1 = 1
  END IF
  G40_05_PRED_1 = G40_05_PRED_1
END FUNCTION
